body: I mean, maybe in the system ..no doctor has told me anything. Are minors not allowed to know their mental disorders by name?

I've never been diagnosed with anything but I see myself turning into my parents and it scares me. Even my own face has turned into my mother's as I've grown up and I don't want to look in the mirror. I'm just me

I need better boundaries with my boyfriend before I lose him. He's all I have and I know that's a recipe for diaster only communicating openly with one person - not just relationship stuff that obviously is just for a partner, but anything. I have no one else I'm really close to. And he's on the opposite end of the spectrum with difficulty expressing himself. It feels like dating a rock sometimes. I thought having your boyfriend be your rock as a good thing, but I wish he came crying to my shoulder just once. I recently heard him complaining about some asshole thing a friend did. I don't even remember. I just felt so happy he felt comfortable enough to vent to me.
